name: smartwrite-ai
description: SmartWrite AI - run backend + desktop together

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,desktop -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:desktop"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k -n backend,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:web:frontend"
scripts.preview:web: npm run build:web && concurrently -k -n backend,preview -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run preview --prefix desktop-app -- --host 127.0.0.1"
scripts.setup: cd backend && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
